clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken herbalists now harvest rare plants at Bathran's Haunt, east of the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Their work is withering the woodland around the ancient kaldorei ruin.

At Bathran's Haunt, crumbling night elf pillars stand north of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran, tangled in Ashenvale's thick foliage. Once a tranquil kaldorei relic, the ruin now shelters Forsaken herbalists and their enforcers. They work among the broken marble in an open-air laboratory, harvesting rare woodland reagents for their experiments. The grass rots brown, blossoms wilt, and decay creeps through the grove as their work blights the ancient soil.

Bathran's Hair, a unique remedial herb, grows only among these stones. Night elf and Alliance scouts see its harvest as a desecration of sacred elven soil, while Forsaken herbalists seek the plant's potent properties. The Horde has an interest in the herb's yield, but the Forsaken keep their methods secret. The corruption of the earth draws suspicion from outsiders and allies alike.
